feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 September 2026 4:44pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 23 September 2026 at 4:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing tomorrow.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic as a ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 at first, becoming variable 3 or less later this evening, gradually settling southeast overnight. Increasing 4 or 5 early tomorrow morning, then 5 or 6 early afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming slight or moderate for tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 to 6, veering west or northwest 2 to 4 overnight into Friday. Gradually backing southwest through Friday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate falling slight overnight into Friday.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then outbreaks of rain arriving Thursday evening and overnight into Friday. Clearing to become fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
